# Atropos
> Integrated technology for Tasmanian homes and businesses — Hobart, Tasmania, Australia

## About
Atropos designs and installs integrated technology across residential and commercial projects in Tasmania: control and automation, home theatre and meeting spaces, distributed audio, networks, digital signage, and acoustic treatment. We work with homeowners, business owners, builders and architects. Parent company: Atropos Industries Pty Ltd, Hobart, TAS 7000.

## Services

### Residential
- Smart Home Automation: Whole-home integration of lighting, climate, security, blinds, and entertainment. Specialists across RTI, Control4, Crestron and other major platforms rather than tied to any one of them, with custom mobile, tablet and web interfaces where a project calls for it. New builds and retrofits.
- Home Theatre: Bespoke design, acoustic treatment, Dolby Atmos installation, 4K laser projection, and professional calibration.
- Distributed Audio / Full-home Sound: Multi-room audio with Bluesound, Sonance, KEF, and Bowers & Wilkins. Outdoor audio included.
- Network & Wi-Fi: Enterprise-grade whole-home Wi-Fi and structured cabling using Ubiquiti UniFi, Ruckus, and Cisco Meraki.

### Commercial
- Audio Visual: Meeting rooms and conferencing, zoned audio and paging, digital signage and displays for workplaces and venues.
- Automation & Smart Lighting: Scheduling, occupancy sensing and multi-tenant zoning for offices, retail and hospitality — lighting, climate and AV governed from one system across floors and tenancies.
- Networking & Wi-Fi: Networks monitored and patched on a schedule, segmented so a compromised device cannot reach the rest of the business.
- Managed Services: Proactive monitoring and scheduled maintenance, with response times scoped per site.

## Service Area
All of Tasmania — Hobart, Launceston, Devonport, Burnie and everywhere between. Based in Hobart.
